headline: Lamar Sits, the Line Runs, Twelve Tickets Move
text:
On the call: Next Man Up at Tenaya Creek in Las Vegas, Follow The Money at SweetWater in Atlanta, Letdown Watch at Union Craft in Baltimore, Skipjack in hand.

Follow The Money: Ravens −2.5 Tuesday. Bengals −3 now. Total 51 down to 46.5.

Next Man Up: Lamar is out. Huntley sta—

Letdown Watch: You froze on the quarterback.

Next Man Up: Huntley starts. The number still ran past four of our cards.

Twelve changes, every original on record. Inactives settle the rest. Unmute.
